ways.label: Tama Lakes Track from Whakapapa Village to Tama Saddle
evidence: Start this track from Whakapapa Village, on the Taranaki Falls Walking Track.
The track ends at a wide, flat clearing on Tama Saddle, with spectacular views of Lower Tama Lake, Mt Ngauruhoe and Mt Ruapehu.

doubts: Start given as Whakapapa Village (place); the text's Taranaki Falls Walking Track start near Ngauruhoe Place is not clearly one road end feature. Shape from DOC distance 'return via same track'. Junction with the Tongariro Northern Circuit mentioned only as where a toilet is.
